limitations: View choice is per capture day; it is not a fixed property of the dataset.
A low projection error bounds what a lateral phone camera could see, not what MediaPipe will actually estimate from it.
A tie means the label data cannot separate those views for this statistic; it is not a statement that either is adequate.

method.supersedes: v1 averaged per-frame error over all frames and took a bare argmin; frames away from the clip extreme carry no threshold information and dominated that average
